answer.rationale: memory_c6 shows multi-year commitments unlocked volume pricing, which can cut unit cost; memory_c1 shows renewing incumbent kept integration stable across two cycles with no migration work or delivery interruption. Together they support renewing the incumbent with longer terms for cost savings and stability, critical given 14-day expiry, 18% spend cut mandate, and 94% line utilization with no buffer. Adding second source or switching vendor adds risk; deferring wastes the 14-day window. Negotiating terms alone may not achieve the 18% cut. Renewing incumbent with multi-year commitment aligns with memories c6 and c1 to reduce unit cost and maintain reliability.
